turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: Outfitter: For the first use, you can keep it simple: - Wash the bottle and cap, either by hand or in the dishwasher. If using a dishwasher, place the cap on the top rack and the gasket in the utensils basket. - Fill it with a cold drink and secure the cap. - Avoid hot or carbonated beverages, food, and perishables. - Don’t put the bottle in the freezer. - Remember that it is non-insulated, so condensation may form on the outside. The cap is leakproof, and the bottle is ready to use on its own.
